# Synthetic provider-shaped fixtures

Every JSON file below is hand-authored synthetic data for deterministic parser and pagination
tests. Symbols, identifiers, prices, corporate actions, request IDs, and page tokens are invented.
No file was downloaded from Massive, Alpaca, Yahoo, an exchange, or any other market-data source.

The fixtures reproduce only the minimal public response shapes needed by the tests. They carry no
redistribution claim over provider data because they contain no provider observations.
